messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership wit
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.
Auto loan applications down. Lending volume index: 79.
People around you are stressed: Betty Kowalski. The mood is tense.

Kevin walked into the interim manager Sandra Briggs's office with the one-pager and refused 'we are still reviewing it' as an answer for the third consecutive tick — she gave him a concrete date: a formal decision by the end of next week. The Amir Patel $12,000 EV charger loan cleared underwriting with a conditional approval, pending one additional piece of business cash flow documentation that Kevin communicated to Amir within the same day. David Chen responded to Kevin's message with the name of the right person to own the portfolio expansion decision (confirming it is Sandra), which validated the approach Kevin took. NMLS progress advanced to 30% with module 7 now logged, and Kevin wrote down his tick 13 contingency threshold — two regional credit unions and one regional bank identified as external targets if the internal path closes.
